{{Current events|year=2026|month=03|day=1|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[Assassination of Ali Khamenei]]
***[[Iran]] confirms the death of [[Supreme Leader of Iran|supreme leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]] in an attack yesterday in [[Tehran]] by [[Israel]] and the [[United States]]. Forty [[National day of mourning|days of mourning]] are declared. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/28/ayatollah-ali-khamenei-the-leader-who-shaped-irans-defiance (Al Jazeera)]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Cyprus]]
***Iran launches two [[ballistic missile]]s towards [[Cyprus]], not far from the [[Akrotiri and Dhekelia|British military bases]] on the island. They were both intercepted before reaching Cyprus. Cypriot president [[Nikos Christodoulides]] states that the country is not a target of Iran. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2026/03/01/iran-missiles-fired-towards-uk-bases-in-cyprus (''Cyprus Mail'')]
***British [[Royal Air Force]] base [[RAF Akrotiri]] in Cyprus is hit by a drone after declaring a security threat. No casualties are reported. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2026/03/02/security-threat-declared-at-uk-cyprus-bases (''Cyprus Mail'')]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on the United Arab Emirates]]
***Multiple Iranian [[Shahed drones]] strike [[French Navy|French]] [[naval air station]] [[Camp de la Paix]] in [[Abu Dhabi]], [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/iran-drone-attack-caused-fire-base-hosting-french-forces-uae (MENA via The New Arab)]
**[[List of Iranian officials killed during the 2026 Iran conflict|2026 killings of Iranian officials]]
***Key Iranian officials [[Abdolrahim Mousavi]], [[Aziz Nasirzadeh]], [[Mohammad Pakpour]] and [[Ali Shamkhani]] are confirmed killed after an airstrike during a meeting yesterday in Tehran. [https://thehill.com/homenews/ap/ap-international/ap-trump-warns-iran-not-to-escalate-attacks-saying-us-will-strike-back-with-force/mlite/ (''The Hill'')]
***Former [[President of Iran|Iranian president]] [[Mahmoud Ahmadinejad]] is allegedly killed along with his bodyguards in an Israeli [[targeted killing]] strike on his home in [[Narmak]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/reports-emerge-that-ahmadinejad-killed-as-state-media-says-it-cannot-confirm-his-fate/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**High-ranking clerics in Iran declare ''[[jihad]]'' against Israel and the U.S., issuing a [[fatwa]] against them. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2026/03/01/iran-declares-jihad-anti-us-riots-spread-middle-east/ (''The Telegraph'')]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] launches a new wave of airstrikes across [[Tehran]], targeting [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] (IRGC) and [[Basij]] facilities with multiple explosions reported. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/explosions-heard-in-tehran-as-new-israeli-airstrikes-hit-iranian-capital/3844811 (AA)]
**A person is injured in a [[drone warfare|drone strike]] on [[Duqm]] port in [[Oman]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/1-injured-in-drone-strike-on-oman-s-duqm-port-amid-us-israeli-confrontation-with-iran/3844783 (AA)]
**A [[Palau]]-flagged [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]] is struck by a missile in the [[Gulf of Oman]], injuring four crew members. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/oil-tanker-hit-off-oman-coast-after-drones-strike-duqm-port-2026-03-01/ (Reuters)]
**An Iranian drone strikes the [[Crowne Plaza|Crowne Plaza Hotel]] in [[Manama]], [[Bahrain]], which houses [[Embassy of the United States, Manama|American embassy]] personnel. No casualties are reported. [https://www.egyptindependent.com/iranian-strike-on-hotel-in-bahrain-forces-us-embassy-personnel-evacuation/ (''Egypt Independent'')]
**Nine people are killed and 49 others are wounded in an Iranian ballistic missile strike on a [[synagogue]] in [[Beit Shemesh]], [[Jerusalem District]], Israel. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/beit-shemesh-missile-strike-death-toll-rises-to-8/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://edition.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-iran-attack-02-28-26-hnk-intl (CNN)]
**The IRGC says it has launched missiles at the [[United States Navy]] [[aircraft carrier]] [[USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72)|USS ''Abraham Lincoln'']] in the [[Indian Ocean]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cn5ge95q6y7t (BBC News)]
**Three [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. service members]] are killed and five others are seriously wounded in an Iranian missile strike, according to the [[United States Central Command]]. [https://www.lbc.co.uk/article/three-service-members-killed-five-injured-iran-uss-abraham-lincoln-5HjdTgC_2/ (LBC)]
**Four [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] members are killed in an unidentified airstrike targeting one of their headquarters in [[Diyala Governorate]], Iraq. [https://www.alarabiya.net/arab-and-world/iraq/2026/03/01/%D9%85%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%84-4-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B4%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%B9%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%87%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1%D9%87%D9%85-%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82 (Al Arabiya)]
**The [[Islamic Republic of Iran Navy]]'s lead [[Moudge-class frigate]] [[IRIS Jamaran (76)|IRIS ''Jamaran'']] is sunk by U.S forces off [[Chabahar Port]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-says-it-sinks-iranian-warship-2026-03-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Southern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Southern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch [[artillery]] strikes on [[Kherson]], [[Ukraine]], killing three people and wounding two others. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4096831-invaders-shell-kherson-leaving-three-dead-and-two-wounded.html (Ukrinform)]
*[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war]]
**[[Anti-aircraft warfare|Anti-aircraft fire]] is reported over [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]], as [[Pakistan Air Force|Pakistani]] warplanes launch strikes against [[Taliban]] targets. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20260301-explosions-kabul-afghan-forces-pakistani-aircraft (France 24)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**The [[Tatmadaw]] launches airstrikes against a trading junction in the central [[Magway Region]] of [[Myanmar]], killing 25 people and injuring 20 people. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-military-airstrikes-magway-region-mindon-127430167405be8ad23bb88d69f54e87 (AP)]
*At least 169 people are killed when insurgents raid a village in [[Abiemnom County]], [[Ruweng Administrative Area]], [[South Sudan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-sudan-violence-insurgents-69a8a9bf191c0c2d8583fbc37ff9ae70 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran conflict]]
**[[Denmark|Danish]] shipping firm [[Maersk]] says that it is suspending all vessel transits through the [[Strait of Hormuz]] until further notice due to the ongoing conflict in the [[Persian Gulf]]. [https://www.brecorder.com/news/40409561/maersk-suspends-vessel-transit-through-strait-of-hormuz (AFP via ''Business Recorder'')]
**[[US-Bangla Airlines]] announces that they will resume flights to [[Oman]] and [[Saudi Arabia]] as scheduled. However, they also announce they will temporarily suspend flights to [[Qatar]] and the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/amp/bangladesh/404415/us-bangla-resumes-flights-to-ksa-oman (''Dhaka Tribune'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 17 people are killed and 18 others are critically injured in an explosion at an explosives factory in [[Nagpur district]], [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/sbl-energy-limited-17-killed-in-blast-at-explosives-manufacturing-company-near-nagpur-11153212 (NDTV)] [https://www.dnaindia.com/india/report-maharashtra-massive-explosion-at-explosive-factory-in-nagpur-s-katol-15-killed-18-injured-3201845 (''DNA'')]
*Four people are killed and ten others are missing after a boat carrying migrants toward Europe capsizes off the coast of [[Tobruk]], [[Libya]], according to the [[United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2634950/world (Arab News)]
*Six people are killed and seven others are injured when a coach bus collides with a truck near Kyakabuga, [[Kyankwanzi District]], [[Uganda]]. [https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/news/national/six-dead-seven-injured-as-bus-collides-with-truck-in-kyankwanzi-5375836 (Monitor)]
*Two Canadian nationals are killed and 18 others are injured in a bus crash near Cumayasa, [[La Altagracia Province]], [[Dominican Republic]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/calgary/article/sunwing-guests-in-fatal-bus-crash-in-dominican-republic/ (CTV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
**[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araqchi]] says that he has told [[Oman]] [[Foreign Ministry (Oman)|foreign minister]] [[Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi]] that [[Iran]] is open to serious efforts at de-escalation. [https://en.apa.az/asia/iran-open-to-efforts-for-de-escalation-oman-says-494049 (APA)]
**[[President of the United States|US president]] [[Donald Trump]] claims that the Iranian leadership agreed to talks a day after Israel and the US launched strikes against Iran and stated he has agreed to do so. However, [[Supreme National Security Council|Iranian security council]] secretary [[Ali Larijani]] ruled out any negotiations. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-iran-strikes-talks/ (CBS News)] [https://www.iranintl.com/fa/202603021322 (Iran International)] [https://www.wionews.com/world/khamenei-s-top-aide-larijani-rules-out-negotiations-with-us-after-trump-says-i-have-agreed-to-talk-what-s-next-for-iran-1772424924420 (WION)]
*[[Belgium–Russia relations]]
**[[Belgium]]'s special forces, with [[France|French]] [[French Navy|Naval]] assistance, seize a [[Russia]]n [[Russian shadow fleet|shadow fleet]] [[oil tanker]] in the [[North Sea]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/03/01/belgium-with-france-s-assistance-seizes-suspected-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker_6750977_4.html (Le Monde)]  

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 attack on the United States consulate in Karachi]]
**Hundreds of protestors attempted to storm the [[Consulate General of the United States, Karachi|consulate of the United States]] in [[Karachi]], [[Pakistan]], leading to clashes with security forces which left at least 22 people dead and multiple others wounded. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-protesters-attacked-us-consulate-karachi-iran-a3cc0c3c6f126cc54a657f61d312a203 (AP)]
*[[2026 Austin bar shooting]]
**Three people are killed, including the perpetrator, and 14 others are injured in a [[Mass shootings in the United States|mass shooting]] at a [[Bar (establishment)|bar]] in [[Austin, Texas|Austin]], [[Texas]], United States. The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] is investigating the attack as potential [[Terrorism in the United States|terrorism]]. [https://www.kvue.com/article/news/local/active-attack-reported-in-downtown-austin/269-1a19c462-1416-4316-8dba-732c395fbfcf (KVUE)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Iranian Supreme Leader election]]
**Iran appoints [[Ayatollah]] [[Alireza Arafi]] to the [[Interim Leadership Council]] that assumed authority following the assassination of [[Supreme Leader of Iran|supreme leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]], with the body set to govern alongside [[President of Iran|president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]] and [[Chief Justice of Iran|chief justice]] [[Gholam-Hossein Mohseni-Eje'i]] until the [[Assembly of Experts]] selects a new supreme leader. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2026/03/01/iran-names-alireza-arafi-to-leadership-council-after-khamenei-killing (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Venezuelans|Venezuelan]] [[Venezuelan opposition|opposition leader]] and [[Nobel Peace Prize]] laureate [[María Corina Machado|Maria Corina Machado]] says she will return to [[Venezuela|the country]] in the coming weeks. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/opposition-leader-maria-corina-machado-says-she-will-return-venezuela-coming-2026-03-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[AI boom]], [[Regulation of artificial intelligence]]
**[[Vietnam]]'s [[artificial intelligence]] (AI) law takes effect, mandating labeling of [[AI-generated content]] and disclosure when users interact with automated systems. The law, which applies to domestic and foreign developers, providers, and deployers operating in the country, also provides for the creation of a national [[AI data center]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/vietnam-ai-law-takes-effect-first-in-south-east-asia (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
